name: Zombi Apokalipsis
source:
A breakthrough in the field of genetics has led to a new leap in human evolution. Now scientists have discovered about the secret of eternal life! The new vaccine was tested on old people who want to acquire a second youth. But no one knows what the side effects brings a new vaccine...

Katya and her brother Valentin gathered to go to the cafe, but suddenly sounded a siren warning the public about the danger. Valentin decided to go and find out more about what had happened. But he did not know the horror with which he will meet in the dark streets of the city...

[From Google Play]
translation:
遗传学领域的突破导致了人类进化的新飞跃。现在科学家发现了永生的秘密！新疫苗在想要获得第二个青春的老年人身上进行了测试。但没有人知道新疫苗会带来什么副作用……

卡蒂亚和她的兄弟瓦伦丁聚集到咖啡馆，但突然响起警报，警告公众注意危险。瓦伦丁决定去进一步了解到底发生了什么。但他不知道，在这座城市的黑暗街道上，他将会遇到怎样的恐怖……
